subject: Post-call recap: procurement path, economic buyer and champion enablement
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orion.software>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement path, economic buyer and champion enablement

Alex — thanks for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of call
- Use case: customer support triage + automated agent responses for priority issues (pilot).
- Target KPI: 30% reduction in average handle time and 20% faster first reply for Tier 1.
- Desired pilot start: mid-April.

Key open items (procurement & risk)
1) Procurement packet / procurement timeline — Alex mentioned an internal procurement window the week of 4/5.
2) Security evidence: SOC2, data residency, SSO (SAML) details.
3) Economic buyer — we need the name and estimated spend authority (approx $/yr).

Proposed next steps
- I attached a short Procurement_Checklist.pdf to surface the typical docs your procurement/legal team asks for (TAs, standard SLA, SOC2 pack). Can you loop in your procurement/IT contact?
- Ben / Rachel: can you draft a one-page champion playbook + 1-slide ROI summary I can hand to Alex? See the ROI model link below for numbers to anchor.
- Alex: if possible, introduce the economic buyer and procurement lead on a single thread this week; I can join a 30-min sync to walk through timelines and success metrics.

Attachments: [Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.pdf]
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cROI

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-03-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement path, economic buyer and champion enablement

Thanks Soojin — good notes. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: Procurement will compile vendor docs the week of 4/5 and expects final approvals by ~4/20. They want SSO & data retention commitments up front.
- Security: Priya (cc'd) is our Security Ops lead. Can you confirm we have an up-to-date SOC 2 report, data retention options, and SAML SSO? Also need details on logging/audit exports for our auditors.
- Economic buyer: Likely our VP of CX, Michael Grant — I can try to surface him next week but want the short one-pager you mentioned so I can brief him quickly.

If you can send the one-pager + a short email template for me to forward to Michael, that would help move this along. Also please include a simple pricing anchor for a 6-month pilot with expected token/usage assumptions.

Alex
Director, Product Ops
Orion Software

Folks — quick ask so we can enable Alex's champion: 
- Soojin: can you produce a 1-page champion brief and a 1-slide ROI summary by end of day Monday? We need: outcome-led talk track for Michael (economic buyer), procurement checklist for Priya, and a pricing anchor for a 6-month pilot.
- Karthik: please include 2 quick technical bullets on integration effort (SSO + 2-way event publishing) and a suggested handoff doc for engineering.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: procurement path, economic buyer and champion enablement — Champion packet & next steps

Ben / Karthik / Rachel — thanks for the quick turnaround. Drafts below (copy these into the one-pager and slide). I also attached the ROI_model_v1.xlsx with baseline inputs. I will join the procurement sync once Alex loops in Priya / Michael.

Champion one-page (talk tracks)
- Elevator (for Michael, VP of CX): "We’ll reduce your Tier 1 handle time by ~30% and cut repeat escalations by 15% through a lightweight pilot that integrates with your existing ticketing system. Expected ROI: ~1.5–2x within 6 months because of agent time savings and fewer escalations."
- Why Redwood: production-first runtime, predictable latency, and built-in caching that keeps token costs low. Emphasize cost controls (batching, quantization profiles) and SSO + audit logging for compliance.
- Success metrics: AHT, first-response time, escalation rate, agent satisfaction. Pilot acceptance criteria: live in sandbox, 1000 tickets/day coverage, measurable 20% improvement on AHT in 30 days.

Procurement checklist (to send to Priya) — quick bullets to include in the packet
- SOC 2 report (we will provide most recent)
- SAML SSO metadata + test account
- Data retention & deletion policy + audit log export instructions
- Standard MSA + proposed SLA (30-day review, 99.9% uptime in Dedicated tier)
- Insurance & data processing addendum

Pricing anchor (6-month pilot)
- Suggested anchor: $48k for 6 months (includes dedicated capacity cap, up to estimated token volume in ROI model). We can propose a consumption + committed blend with a pilot credit to shorten time to value.

Email template for Alex to forward to Michael (2 lines + ask)
"Michael — quick intro: we recently reviewed Redwood Inference for a pilot to speed up our support channels and reduce AHT. They’re production-grade and have a short 4–6 week pilot path. Can we book 20 minutes this week for Soojin to walk through goals and success metrics? — Alex"

Attachments: [Attachment: ROI_model_v1.xlsx], [Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.pdf]
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cROI
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1743

Next steps (owner):
- Alex: introduce Michael and Priya on this thread (ASAP).
- Soojin: I will join the procurement call and provide SOC2 + SSO artifacts.
- Ben: can you confirm pricing anchor and provide final one-pager by EOD Monday?

Thanks — I’ll follow up after the intro.

— Soojin Lee
